en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Mansour Bin Yunus, from Abu Hamza, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5<sup>th</sup> or 6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) having said:

‘(Someone) came to Rasool-Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, so he said to him<sup>saww</sup>: ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! There has been killing in Juhayna’. So Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> arose, and walked until he<sup>saww</sup> ended up in their Masjid. He<sup>saww</sup> said, and the people heard him<sup>saww</sup>, so they came over, so he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Who had done that killing?’ They said, ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! We do not know’.

So he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘There has been killing in between the Muslims, and it is not known who killed? By the One Who<sup>azwj</sup> Sent me<sup>saww</sup> with the Truth, if the inhabitants of the sky and the earth were to participate in shedding the blood of a Muslim person, and were pleased with it, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Fling them upon their nostrils, into the Fire!’ – or he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Upon their faces!’.
